title: Downstream servers carry unused direct deps
description: smallhold and broadside list direct dependencies on crates they never 'use' directly -- those crates are only accessed transitively through fieldwork features. smallhold: ammonia, argon2, blurhash, image, whatlang, pulldown-cmark, subtle (7 crates). broadside: ammonia, blurhash (2 crates confirmed unused). These don't affect compilation (Cargo deduplicates), but they create version-sync maintenance burden: updating these versions in both places, and risk of silent version divergence if fieldwork pins differently than the downstream server.
close_reason: Accepted: small maintenance burden. cargo-machete can identify these but the risk is zero — unused deps don't affect runtime behavior.
